Title: Admins may be unable to access Content Explorer or Data Explorer in Microsoft Purview

User impact: Admins may be unable to access Content Explorer or Data Explorer in Microsoft Purview.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Purview and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Admins may be unable to access Content Explorer or Data Explorer in Microsoft Purview

User impact: Admins may be unable to access Content Explorer or Data Explorer in Microsoft Purview.

Current status: We suspect a potential authentication issue may be occurring resulting in impact to admins. We're investigating service health telemetry in parallel with Microsoft Purview logs to confirm this theory and determine our next troubleshooting steps. 

Scope of impact: This issue may affect any admin attempting to access Content Explorer or Data Explorer in Microsoft Purview. 

Next update by: Monday, August 24, 2026, at 5:30 PM UTC
